えぐ.definition: [Pronunciation]: Egu. If you put えぐ into [google translate] a bunch of times, you get a random strain of words that usually have to do with eggs (search えぐ on youtube to get a video on how this works). Most common word in this [translation] is "decearing egg"
えぐ.example:
Person 1: DUDE, I [TRANSLATED] えぐ A BUNCH OF TIMES AND I GOT [RANDOM SHIT] ABOUT EGGS [YOU SHOULD] TOTALLY TRY IT
Person 2: Ok dude I totally will
